source.description: Approved eight-panel handmade raster graphite and colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into JPG masters.
source.notes: Generate only after the shared August 14 lock and this slug preflight pass.

process_strategy: A single curled red panda is built from a branch axis and three pale masses, then receives its branch overlap, face, striped tail, graphite texture, restrained color, and final reinforcement without changing pose or countable features.

final_elements.name: curled red panda silhouette
final_elements.description: One left-facing red panda curled into a compact sleeping crescent.

final_elements.name: branch with fork
final_elements.description: One diagonal branch and one short fork, reserved behind the panda body.

final_elements.name: face and ears
final_elements.description: Two rounded ears, closed eyes, a small nose, and pale cheek-mask shapes.

final_elements.name: striped tail
final_elements.description: One broad tail wrapping along the lower body with exactly four pale stripe bands.

final_elements.name: restrained color and shadow
final_elements.description: Rust, cream, and cool-gray colored-pencil layers with one broken branch shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The branch's keeper lines stop behind the planned belly and tail footprint.
Body texture and branch marks stop at the tail route.

frames.visible_job: Place a diagonal branch, its fork, a round head, bean body, tail arc, and shadow footprint in pale graphite.
Connect the head and body into one compact curled panda silhouette while preserving branch and tail reserves.

frames.step_name: Lay in the tail and paws
frames.visible_job: Add one wrapping tail, exactly four pale tail stripe bands, and two tucked paw masses.
Add two ears, closed eyes, nose, cheek masks, and small paw toes.
Strengthen established graphite texture and add restrained rust, cream, warm brown, and cool-gray colored-pencil layers to existing forms.

new_occlusions: panda silhouette covers the reserved branch middle
tail covers its reserved lower-body route

final_step.visible_job: Only clarifies established keeper contours, pencil texture, color, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject changed pose, tail stripe count, ear count, or branch fork.
Reject a final that first adds facial features, tail stripes, branch texture, color, or shadow.
Reject vector-clean or polished poster-like art; keep visible pencil tooth and handmade variation.
